name: Fellou
tagline: Agentic browser that plans and executes web tasks for you.
description: Fellou is an AI browser that goes beyond chat by embedding agents that autonomously carry out multi-step web work — deep research across many tabs, competitor analysis, form filling, file handling, and cross-app workflows — from a natural-language prompt. It first generates a step-by-step action plan you can review and edit, then executes it while letting you intervene at any step. It runs as a downloadable desktop browser and can analyze local files dragged into the interface.
insight: Markets itself as the first 'agentic browser'; later shipped Fellou CE, billed as a spatial (Z-axis) edition with local-first execution.
edge: Plans a visible, editable action plan and then autonomously executes multi-site tasks — research, forms, reports — instead of just answering questions.
pros: Review and intervene at any step

references.title: Fellou Browser: Agentic Features, Pros/Cons, and Security
